basic_info.name: الجامعة الأمريكية في مادبا
basic_info.campus_area: 100 acres (50 hectares), 8 km outside Madaba city

admission_requirements.general_requirements: Jordanian General Secondary Certificate (Tawjihi) or equivalent. Must meet minimum acceptance grades per program and pass Ministry of Education placement tests. Non-Jordanian certificates require equivalency from Ministry of Education.
admission_requirements.min_tawjihi_mark: 60% (varies by faculty: 60% Science/IT/Business/Languages, 70% Health Sciences, 80% Engineering/Pharmacy/Architecture)
admission_requirements.exam_details: Placement tests in English, Arabic, and Computer skills administered by the university. Students who fail any test must take remedial courses during the first year.
admission_requirements.english_requirement: English placement test at admission. Graduate programs require TOEFL (59-90) or IELTS (5-6.5) depending on program, or conditional admission with six credit hours of English.
admission_requirements.diploma_bridging: College diploma holders can pursue bachelor's through bridging program after passing comprehensive exam

graduate_fees.risk_management: 175 JD per credit hour, 475 JD per semester

tuition_fees.notes: Tuition varies by faculty and credit hour. Fees subject to change. Non-Jordanian charges are in USD.

scholarships.additional_discounts: Extra 5% for Madaba residents and MOU partner school graduates
scholarships.graduate_scholarships: Corporate discounts (15-25%) for group enrollments in MBA programs
scholarships.conditions: Partial scholarships apply to tuition fees only, do not cover registration fees or summer terms. Highest applicable scholarship applies if multiple qualify.

accreditation.jordanian: Ministry of Higher Education and Scientific Research (MOHE), Accreditation and Quality Assurance Commission for Higher Education Institutions (HEAC)
accreditation.american: Authorized by New Hampshire Department of Education, Commission on Higher Education; Candidate for Accreditation by New England Commission of Higher Education (NECHE) - Approved November 2024, next comprehensive evaluation Spring 2029

ranking_accreditation.international_recognition: Registered as U.S. educational entity (AUM Inc.) in New Hampshire (incorporated 2013); member of Association of Arab Universities (AArU), International Association of Universities (IAU), Association of Catholic Colleges and Universities (ACCU)

market_demand.employment_rate: Excellent - described as 'almost most students find work after graduation' (Vatican Source); consistently strong graduate outcomes reported
market_demand.notable_achievements: Pharmacy faculty ranked first in Jordanian board examinations for four consecutive years
market_demand.notes: Business and IT programs designed to align with market demands. Curriculum updated regularly including AI for Business, Digital Business Strategy, Cybersecurity, and Digital Marketing.

campus_facilities.campus_size: 100 acres (50 hectares), located 8 km outside Madaba
campus_facilities.accommodation_details: House of Grace female dormitory opened July 2018, 3,490 sqm, 88 single rooms + 3 supervisor rooms. Air-conditioned, free Wi-Fi, main kitchen, gym, study lounge, laundry, outdoor spaces. Fee: 150 JD/month plus sales tax.
campus_facilities.sports_facilities: Indoor swimming pool (semi-Olympic), basketball, football, volleyball, tennis courts, fitness center, weightlifting room, table tennis - both indoor and outdoor
campus_facilities.medical_center: On-campus medical center with multiple clinics, periodic Medical Wellness Days, psychological counseling services
campus_facilities.geothermal_system: Largest geothermal heating and cooling system in the Middle East - environmentally friendly campus

contact_info.address: PO Box 2882, Amman 11821, Jordan (Theban St., Madaba)
contact_info.campus_location: MR62+F79, Madaba, Jordan (8 km outside city)
